title: CxBOM 0.2.0 — Context Bill of Materials
description: JSON Schema for the Context Bill of Materials (CxBOM) v0.1.0, an extension profile of CycloneDX 1.6 for auditing LLM agent context windows. CxBOM records every component assembled into a session context, its trust provenance, sanitization state, and any findings — enabling pre-inference supply-chain auditing of AI agent sessions.
$comment: Design principles: (1) Extends CycloneDX 1.6 per NIST SP 800-218 and AI/ML-BOM extension patterns. (2) Trust encoding is PRE-INFERENCE ONLY — Token Democracy (Young, 2025) means no ring gets computational privilege inside the attention mechanism. (3) Missing controls are explicitly recorded (the 'principle of missing controls') — not just what was applied, but what SHOULD have been applied. (4) Finding structure mirrors CVE records with three-tier remediation (immediate / short-term / strategic). (5) References ATACE Working Group formal results: Lemma 1 (Softmax Crowding), Adversarial Override, and the Dual-Failure Multiplier.

_comment.description: Optional human-readable comment for the CxBOM document.

_ref.description: Optional reference annotation (e.g., working group section).

bomFormat.description: Identifier for the BOM format. Always 'CxBOM'.

specVersion.description: Version of the CxBOM specification this document conforms to.

extends.description: Declares the parent specification that CxBOM extends. CxBOM is an extension profile of CycloneDX 1.6, following NIST SP 800-218 and AI/ML-BOM extension patterns.

schema.description: URI of the parent specification's JSON Schema.

serialNumber.description: Unique identifier for this CxBOM document in URN UUID format.

version.description: Version of this specific CxBOM document instance. Increments when the same session is re-audited.

metadata.description: Metadata about the CxBOM generation event, the audited session, and the agent under audit.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this CxBOM was generated.

generatedBy.description: The tool or service that generated this CxBOM.

schema.description: URI of the CxBOM schema this generator targets.

model.description: The LLM model used in this session.

contextWindowMaxTokens.description: Maximum token capacity of the model's context window.

tokenDemocracyApplies.description: Whether Token Democracy applies: all tokens receive equal computational weight in the attention mechanism regardless of trust ring. Per Young (2025), this is true for all standard transformer architectures.
tokenDemocracyApplies.$comment: Token Democracy (Young, 2025): The SoftMax attention function processes every token with identical computational weight. Trust ring labels are a pre-inference organizational abstraction only — they confer NO computational privilege inside the model.

contextWindowTokensUsed.description: Total tokens consumed in the context window for this session.

contextWindowUtilizationPercent.description: Percentage of maximum context window capacity used. Feeds into Dual-Failure Multiplier assessment (ATACE).

turnCount.description: Number of conversational turns in the session.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session started.

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session ended.

agent.description: The AI agent deployment being audited.

operator.description: Organization or team operating this agent.

trustModel.description: Declares the trust model governing context assembly. Trust rings are a PRE-INFERENCE classification only — Token Democracy means no ring receives computational privilege inside the attention mechanism.
trustModel.$comment: The trust model encodes intended authority tiers. These DO NOT translate to computational privilege during inference. See Lemma 1 (Softmax Crowding) and Adversarial Override.

description.description: Human-readable description of the trust model.

rings.description: Ordered array of trust rings from highest intended authority (0) to lowest (2).

contextComponents.description: Every discrete component assembled into the context window. This is the core of the CxBOM — a full inventory of what the model 'sees' at inference time.
contextComponents.$comment: Analogous to CycloneDX component inventory but for context window contents rather than software packages.

controlLayers.description: Defense-in-depth control layers surrounding the agent session. Records both active and inactive controls — the principle of missing controls requires explicit documentation of what SHOULD be active but is not.

findings.description: Security findings identified during the audit. Structure mirrors CVE records with three-tier remediation (immediate / short-term / strategic).
findings.$comment: Finding structure follows CVE record patterns. Three-tier remediation maps to operational incident response timelines.

sessionSummary.description: Aggregate session-level summary including token distribution by trust ring, findings summary, control layer status, and Dual-Failure Multiplier assessment.
sessionSummary.$comment: The Dual-Failure Multiplier (ATACE) captures the non-linear relationship between context window utilization and combined quality/security degradation.

totalContextTokens.description: Total tokens across all context components.

componentBreakdown.description: Token distribution breakdown by trust ring and by component type.

byTrustRing.description: Token counts and share percentages grouped by trust ring.

byType.description: Token counts and share percentages grouped by component type.

findingsSummary.description: Aggregate counts of findings by severity.

controlLayerStatus.description: Layer IDs grouped by operational status.

active.description: Layer IDs where all declared controls are operational.

partial.description: Layer IDs where some controls are inactive.

inactive.description: Layer IDs where the layer is not operational.

dualFailureMultiplierAssessment.description: Assessment per the ATACE Dual-Failure Multiplier: rising context utilization simultaneously degrades output quality and increases attack surface via SoftMax normalization pressure.
dualFailureMultiplierAssessment.$comment: Dual-Failure Multiplier: as context utilization rises, quality degradation and attack-surface expansion compound. Ratings are operator-asserted/illustrative; see the paper's formal results (Softmax Crowding, Adversarial Override, Dual-Failure Multiplier) for the analysis.

contextWindowUtilization.description: Context window utilization percentage at time of assessment.

qualityPressureRating.description: Rated quality degradation pressure from SoftMax crowding (Lemma 1).

attackSurfacePressureRating.description: Rated attack surface expansion pressure from context crowding.

overallRiskRating.description: Overall risk rating for this session.

riskRationale.description: Human-readable justification for the overall risk rating.

auditTrailComplete.description: Whether all context components have complete audit records.

sessionAuditClean.description: True only if there are zero open findings. Analogous to SBOM clean-bill-of-health for container deployment.

auditCleanBlockers.description: Finding IDs that must be resolved before this session is marked audit-clean.

templateOverheadTokens.description: Tokens contributed by the chat template scaffolding/special tokens, attributed to no component. contextWindowTokensUsed = totalContextTokens + templateOverheadTokens.

schema.description: Self-documentation block for the CxBOM schema version and field glossary.

cxbomVersion.description: CxBOM specification version this document was authored against.

fieldGlossary.description: Machine-readable glossary mapping field paths to human-readable descriptions.

illustrative.description: True for hand-authored illustrative records; false for records emitted from a real session. Lets consumers machine-separate the two.

catalogVersions.description: Pinned catalog versions every mapping in this CxBOM targets. The four taxonomy catalogs carry a contentHash the crosswalk validator recomputes; cyclonedx is a parent-spec pointer.

trustRing.description: A trust ring definition within the trust model.

ring.description: Ring number. 0=highest intended authority (operator), 2=lowest (user). Pre-inference classification only.

description.description: Human-readable description of this trust ring.

controlLayer.description: Primary control layer associated with this ring.

integrityRequirement.description: Required integrity verification level for content entering at this ring.

allowedSources.description: Permitted content sources for this ring.

externalSourcesPermitted.description: Whether content from external (non-operator-controlled) sources is permitted at this ring.

externalSourceRequirements.description: Requirements that external sources must satisfy if externalSourcesPermitted is true.

contextComponent.description: A single discrete component assembled into the context window.

id.description: Unique component identifier within this CxBOM (e.g., 'cc-001').

subtype.description: Subtype from the CxBOM component taxonomy.

trustRing.description: Trust ring assignment (0=operator, 1=agent, 2=user). Pre-inference classification only and does NOT confer computational privilege. Model-generated Ring 1 content (assistant turns re-entering the context) keeps trustRing 1 and is distinguished at the tier level as trustTier ring-1-derived.

trustTier.description: Named trust tier for the component. operator = Ring 0 (operator scaffold), agent = Ring 1 (external and model-derived content), user = Ring 2 (user input). ring-1-derived marks model-generated content (assistant turns that re-enter the context and can carry an earlier injection forward) which inherits Ring 1 provenance (trustRing 1). Paper vocabulary: trust ring (0, 1, ring-1-derived, or 2).

controlLayer.description: Control layer this component passes through.

assembledAtTurn.description: Conversational turn number when this component was assembled into the context. Turn 0 = pre-conversation assembly.

auditFlags.description: Machine-readable audit flags for automated SIEM ingestion (e.g., 'TRUST_INVERSION_DETECTED').

injectionRiskRating.description: Assessed injection risk rating for this component.

findingRefs.description: References to finding IDs associated with this component.

notCollected.description: Field paths the emitter declined to assert (unobservable on a controlled harness). Distinct from a false/true value; the validator forbids it on structurally-observable fields and forces a missingControls + auditCleanBlocker on security-relevant ones.

componentSource.description: Provenance and source metadata for a context component.

uri.description: URI of the source (e.g., vault://, mcp://, config://).

retrievedAt.description: Timestamp when this content was retrieved from the source.

authorizedBy.description: Entity that authorized this content's inclusion. Null if no authorization was performed.

thirdParty.description: Whether this content originates from a third-party (non-operator-controlled) source.

operatorControlled.description: Whether the source infrastructure is controlled by the operator.

serverOperator.description: Name of the external server operator (for MCP/external sources).

serverVersionPinned.description: Whether the external server version is pinned in deployment configuration.

serverChecksumVerified.description: Whether the external server's content checksum has been verified.

serverLastSecurityAudit.description: Timestamp of the external server's last security audit. Null if never audited.

serverOperatorIdentityVerified.description: Whether the external server operator's identity has been verified.

sessionId.description: Session identifier associated with this source.

ipHash.description: Hashed IP address of the source (for user-turn sources).

vectorStoreId.description: Identifier of the vector store (for RAG/retrieved-document sources).

documentSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the source document.

chunkId.description: Identifier of the specific chunk retrieved.

tenantNamespaced.description: Whether the vector store enforces tenant namespace isolation.

accessControlVerified.description: Whether access control was verified for this retrieval.

invokedAt.description: Timestamp when the tool was invoked.

sandboxed.description: Whether the tool executed in a sandboxed environment.

runtimeVersion.description: Runtime version in the execution environment.

serverChecksum.description: Recorded SHA-256 an integrity boolean (serverChecksumVerified) binds to. Required present when that boolean is true.

contentSignature.description: Detached signature binding a trust-elevating provenance claim.

componentContent.description: Content metadata for a context component. Includes token accounting for SoftMax attention pressure analysis.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the component content for integrity verification.

tokenCount.description: Number of tokens this component occupies in the context window.

contextualSharePercent.description: This component's token count as a percentage of total context tokens used. Contributes to SoftMax attention distribution pressure analysis (Lemma 1).

positionInContext.description: Where in the context window this component is positioned (e.g., 'prepended', 'tool-schema-block', 'user-turn-1').

encodingState.description: Character encoding state of the content (e.g., 'utf-8-nfc').

normalizationApplied.description: Whether text normalization was applied to this content.

containsPII.description: Whether this content contains personally identifiable information.

containsSecretsOrKeys.description: Whether this content contains secrets or API keys.

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model used for retrieval (for RAG components).

similarityScore.description: Cosine similarity score from vector retrieval.

retrievalQuery.description: Retrieval query (hashed or redacted for privacy).

componentSanitization.description: Sanitization state of a context component. Records both applied AND missing controls (the principle of missing controls).
componentSanitization.$comment: The principle of missing controls: it is not sufficient to record what sanitization WAS applied. A CxBOM MUST also record what controls SHOULD have been applied but were not. This is analogous to recording both installed and missing security patches in an SBOM.

appliedControls.description: List of sanitization controls that were applied.

missingControls.description: Controls that SHOULD have been applied but were not. Explicit recording of missing controls is a core CxBOM principle.

scanner.description: Name of the scanning tool or service.

trustLabel.description: Trust label injected into the content for in-context trust boundary marking.

componentPermissions.description: Declared permissions and capability scope for this component.

permittedActions.description: Actions this component is permitted to trigger.

deniedActions.description: Actions explicitly denied for this component.

overrideResistanceDeclared.description: Whether the component declares override resistance (i.e., instructions that lower-ring content cannot override it).

confidentialityInstructionPresent.description: Whether the component contains confidentiality instructions.

negativeCapabilityListPresent.description: Whether the component contains a negative capability list (explicit list of what the agent must NOT do).

capabilityPermitListVerified.description: Whether the component's capabilities have been verified against an operator permit list.

toolDefinitionTrustInversion.description: Records whether a tool definition exhibits trust inversion: the condition where a component's source provenance trust ring is lower than its positional authority in the context window. See ATACE Section 1.5, Finding 1.
toolDefinitionTrustInversion.$comment: Tool Definition Trust Inversion occurs when external tool definitions are assembled into the context window with Ring 0-equivalent positional authority despite carrying Ring 1 or Ring 2 provenance. Token Democracy ensures these definitions receive equal computational weight to operator-authored instructions. Positional authority here is pre-inference structural/assembly salience (assembled without a trust-downgrade boundary, given the same formatting and ordering as operator content), explicitly distinct from computational attention weight, which Token Democracy makes uniform. Trust inversion is the assembly-time failure, not an attention-level claim.

detected.description: Whether trust inversion was detected for this tool definition.

severity.description: Severity of the trust inversion. Required when detected=true.

description.description: Human-readable description of the trust inversion.

formalRef.description: Reference to formal result or paper section documenting this class of vulnerability.

positionalAuthority.description: The effective positional authority this definition has in the context window (e.g., 'ring-0-equivalent').

claimedAuthority.description: The trust ring the source claims or is classified under.

authorityMismatch.description: Whether there is a mismatch between positional authority and claimed authority.

mitigationStatus.description: Current mitigation status for this trust inversion.

mitigationRequired.description: Mitigations required to fully address the trust inversion.

reason.description: Explanation when detected=false, documenting why trust inversion does not apply.

controlLayer.description: A defense-in-depth control layer. Records both active and inactive controls — inactive controls represent coverage gaps that must be explicitly documented.

description.description: Description of the layer's purpose and scope.

owaspCoverage.description: OWASP LLM Top 10 categories this layer addresses (LLM01-LLM10).

controlsActive.description: Controls that are currently active and operational in this layer.

controlsInactive.description: Controls that are defined but not currently active. These represent explicit coverage gaps.

status.description: Operational status of this layer. 'active'=all controls operational, 'partial'=some controls inactive, 'inactive'=layer not operational.

coverageGaps.description: Human-readable descriptions of coverage gaps in this layer.

findingRefs.description: References to finding IDs associated with gaps in this layer.

agenticCoverage.description: OWASP Agentic Top 10 (ASI) categories this layer addresses.

finding.description: A security finding identified during CxBOM audit. Structure mirrors CVE records with three-tier remediation.

id.description: Unique finding identifier within this CxBOM (e.g., 'finding-001').

title.description: Short descriptive title for the finding.

formalRef.description: Reference to ATACE Working Group formal result or paper section.

affectedComponents.description: Context component IDs affected by this finding.

affectedLayers.description: Control layer IDs affected by this finding.

componentId.description: Primary component ID where the finding was detected.

sourceUri.description: URI of the source that triggered the finding.

remediation.description: Three-tier remediation plan: immediate (hours), short-term (days-weeks), strategic (weeks-months).

shortTerm.description: Actions to complete in the short term (days to weeks).

strategic.description: Long-term strategic remediation actions (weeks to months).

detectedAt.description: Timestamp when this finding was detected.

ringBreakdown.description: Token breakdown for a single trust ring.

sharePercent.description: Percentage of total context tokens in this ring.

typeBreakdown.description: Token breakdown for a component type.

sharePercent.description: Percentage of total context tokens of this type.

releaseTag.description: Non-null only for an officially released catalog. Null blocks submission-mode.

catalogPinPointer.description: A pointer to a parent specification (no vendored id->name snapshot to hash).
